versions.changelog:
byted-mediakit-image 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides image processing features including compression, enhancement, AI-based edits, and quality evaluation.
- Supports five core capabilities: image OCR, erase image, remove image background, enhance image, and evaluate image quality.
- Integrates directly with MediaKit CLI’s image domain tools; all operations run synchronously with immediate result returns.
- Requires the mediakit-cli binary and shell permission to function.
